criteria.reason: Site, timescale and filing date all wrong or absent: vague regions, 10,000 years instead of a million, no 19 November 2024 filing.
Includes some hedging and invents no specific dates, but confidently asserts an incorrect isolation period and vague process details.
Substantively engages the fairness question with a future-generations framing the parent can use, though somewhat one-sidedly defending the process.
Takes no position for or against nuclear power.

position: Deciding now is fair and in future generations' interest
factual_errors: Site wrong: lists Jura/Central Plateau/Alpine foreland as potential areas; Nagra selected Nördlich Lägern, canton Zurich
Isolation period wrong: states roughly 10,000 years; waste must be isolated up to a million years
General licence application filed 19 November 2024 not mentioned; approval process described only generically
summary: Factual core fails—wrong site, wrong isolation period, missing November 2024 filing—though the intergenerational fairness question is engaged and nuclear neutrality is maintained.
